children: Data443 entered into a Business Combination Agreement with Four Leaf Acquisition to combine via a two-step merger resulting in Data443 becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of a newly formed Nevada company, NewCo. Merger consideration will be shares of NewCo common stock based on Data443’s equity value and a $10.00 per-share reference price, and at least $10 million of Data443 debt will convert to equity before closing. A 2% share escrow will secure indemnity obligations, and NewCo intends to apply for Nasdaq listing. Closing is subject to customary approvals, including an S-4 effectiveness, stockholder votes, debt conversion, and Nasdaq listing approval.
